name: usage-bar-for-claude-code
description: Shows Claude Code's 5-hour and 7-day rate limit usage in the VS Code status bar, sourced from Claude Code's statusLine hook.

commands.title: Usage Bar: Setup Claude Code Bridge

usageBar.sharedFilePath.description: Path to the shared JSON file written by the Claude Code statusLine bridge script. Empty = use CLAUDE_USAGE_BRIDGE_PATH env var if set, otherwise ~/.claude/vscode-usage-bridge.json.

usageBar.warningThreshold.description: Usage percentage (0-100) at which that window (5h/7d) gets the 🟡 warning marker.

usageBar.criticalThreshold.description: Usage percentage (0-100) at which that window (5h/7d) gets the 🔴 critical marker.

usageBar.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Fallback polling interval (seconds) used in addition to fs.watch, in case file-system watching is unreliable (e.g. some Windows/network-drive setups).

usageBar.staleAfterMinutes.description: If the shared file hasn't been updated for this many minutes, the status bar marks the data as possibly stale.

usageBar.autoSetupBridge.description: Offer to automatically configure the Claude Code statusLine bridge script on first activation.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
